note: Vocabularies the checks read (plan.md 5.0, 5.1 S2, 5.4, 6.3, 6.4). JSON is the record; the plan cites it.

claim_kinds.observed: seen directly: a source line, a documented statement read, a run record, an instrument reading
claim_kinds.derived: follows deterministically from observed facts (a computation, a parse); the derivation is the evidence
claim_kinds.inferred: a reading of partial evidence; a recommendation, never a specification
claim_kinds.unknown: no evidence; the claim says what would resolve it (requires)

claim_bases.documentation: manuals, vendor specifications, API documentation, papers
claim_bases.source: source code, configuration files, scripts, repositories read with ordinary tools
claim_bases.binary: a binary or package analysed (REA); needs analysis_permission
claim_bases.runtime: runtime behaviour captured in a replica environment (REA); needs analysis_permission
claim_bases.run_record: logs, result files and run records

cause_status.observed: the phenomenon was seen; no cause claimed
cause_status.suspected: a cause is proposed without run or commit evidence
cause_status.confirmed: the cause is shown by a run or a commit named in evidence[]

setting_states.confirmed: a person checked it or stated it; confirmed_by: human and a date
setting_states.inferred: inferred from code or documents; evidence[] required; a recommendation only
setting_states.unknown: no evidence or not decided; asked, or carried as held

value_kinds.measured: a measurement of the thing itself under stated conditions
value_kinds.correlation: the output of a published correlation or fitted expression
value_kinds.computed: computed from other values by a stated expression
value_kinds.predicted: the output of a predictive model (e.g. a predicted structure)
value_kinds.literature: a value quoted from a publication without its measurement record
value_kinds.estimated: a person's estimate or an assumption with a stated rationale
value_kinds.model_generated: a value an LLM produced; E6; enters no card and no store

grades.E1: measured by this system under these conditions (measured:<run_id>)
grades.E2: a calibration with an expiry, a literature or database measurement
grades.E3: a vendor specification, an operator reading, a run from another repository
grades.E6: a model's guess; forbidden in cards and stores

policy_fields_note: Never inferred (MP11). Must be confirmed before a build or an agent_goal references the profile (check 15). A wizard question may target them at any time (check 16).
